name: The Willard InterContinental
positioning: Historic luxury hotel on Pennsylvania Avenue, steps from the White House, home to the Round Robin Bar, established in 1847
best_for: Travelers who want a walkable base for the White House, the National Mall and the city's monuments and museums
History lovers drawn to rooms and suites that honor U.S. presidents and other notable figures

facts.text: The hotel is at 1401 Pennsylvania Avenue NW in Washington, D.C.
The hotel is within walking distance of many monuments, memorials and museums, including the National Mall and the White House.
The U.S. Capitol Building can be seen from the hotel.
The hotel combines American history and luxury.
Classic Rooms are designed to feel like an elegant private residence.
Classic Rooms have a walk-in marble shower or a shower with bathtub.
The hotel has an Abraham Lincoln Suite.
The hotel has a Martin Luther King Jr. Suite, which may include a Washington Monument view.
The Round Robin Bar is known for its circular bar, oak-paneled walls and the Mint Julep.
Afternoon Tea in Peacock Alley comes with harp music, teas, finger sandwiches, pastries and freshly baked scones.
The Willard Spa has a sauna and steam bathing.
Old Town Trolley tours depart from just outside the hotel.

highlights.text: The Round Robin Bar has been a meeting place for the political and social elite since it was established in 1847.
Rooms and suites honor figures from pioneering women to U.S. presidents through bespoke design, curated art and refined details.
The hotel stands steps from the White House, surrounded by historic monuments and museums.
Premium Rooms may include a Washington Monument view.
The Willard Spa offers custom massages and restorative skin treatments.

considerations.text: The hotel does not have a pool.
WhataHotel notes a busy downtown location with urban noise levels.
